_comment: Declarative HUD layout for the hex-map client. The host parses this and exposes it to Lua as the `UI` global (flicker-script ScriptHost::set_global_json); scripts/hud.lua reads `UI.hud` and emits draw commands. Edit values here to move/recolour the HUD, then relaunch. Colours are RGBA 0..1; positions/sizes are HUD pixels (origin top-left).
